correctness.rationale: Derive a=Kz by integrating infection incidence and b_j=Σ_i(p_i/p_j)K_ij h_i from exponential-lifetime offspring generating functions. Weighted multiplication gives necessary compatibility; K*=a(p*b)^T/T proves sufficiency. Strict positive map subhomogeneity fixes unique selected nonzero outcomes. All positive solutions form K*+{E:Ez=0,(p*h)^T E=0}, of dimension (n−1)^2. Perturbation produces positive rank-two aliases, while equations force rank-one uniqueness. Checked exact 3x3 rational K and 70-digit scalar solutions with standalone script; the all-size proof does not rely on tests.

value.rationale: Provides natural complete feasibility and identifiability classification for two epidemiologically distinct observables: exact consistency check, unique rank-one effective reproduction kernel, and sharp (n−1)^2 observational ambiguity with explicit positive non-rank-one twins. Useful to delineate what aggregate outbreak and attack data can and cannot establish, independently of any large downstream theorem; not just a normalization or known-table recomputation.
